key_insight: Settling particles self-organize into macroscopic fractal clusters that drive multiscale turbulence far beyond individual particle sizes.
engineering_relevance: These findings could inform sedimentation and particle-laden flow models by distinguishing cluster-scale turbulence from particle-scale forcing.
method: Particle-resolved direct numerical simulations of settling particles.
Large domains with high particle volume fractions and density ratios.
Analysis of particle clustering and scale-dependent fluid fluctuations.
evidence_signal: The simulations reveal large-scale, vertically decorrelated cluster-driven fluctuations coexisting with distinct particle-driven high-wavenumber scaling.
watch_item: Generality beyond the simulated high-volume-fraction, high-density-ratio conditions requires further validation.
paper_title: Fractal forcing of turbulence by settling particles
